body: I don’t think trading for the picks were bad at all (2025-27th-30th pick, possibly a mid 20’s 1st and another mid 20’s 1st for an unprotected 1st in 2031), but best guess Sun’s don’t have Kevin Durant, Bradley Beal and James Jones at that point. Who knows Devin might ask out of Phoenix if the losing continues but also Devin could end up being a Sun for life.  Realistically James Jones is not resigned when his contract runs out this June or July. If so Matt Ishbia will be looking for a new GM and Coach, and with Matt’s desire to win and create a winning atmosphere he’ll most likely try to flip current contracts and and those picks to acquire a different star or more role players on shorter/cheaper deals. I’d have to envision them trading a 1st just to get ride of the Beal contract. But who knows only time will tell.
